The most obvious reason why someone would not want to play with their team at a Major is because they've been informed they will be kicked afterwards. I think letting a person know as soon as possible about their removal is the best option, even if it means their performance may suffer. It is the fairest option to the exiting player because it gives them more time to plan their next move, and doesn't make the removal appear to be a consequence of their performance at their most recent tournament. 

Only selfish people like EE would withhold that information until after the tournament because they care more about the team's performance than the player. 

The team probably told Deth that they would kick him after the Major, and included the offer to let him sit out of the Major entirely while receiving his pay cut. Deth accepted, making it mutual. He's exiting the team regardless, so he probably doesn't want to play with them.
